crossRefs.note: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
“Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I…
Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked…
Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth.
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with…
Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.
They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together…
I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

translations.web: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
translations.bsb: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
translations.kjv: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
translations.asv: Arise, O Jehovah; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
